question: Is failing the operator test tied to being a source or only to growing?
inputs: Ticket A's code; the recorded edits, draws and verdicts of the reads-holders-sources study, part C.
forbidden_inputs: Any recomputed release verdict; any definition changed after a value is seen.
primary_observable: Cross-table of recorded verdict against the test by growth kind; knots at first failure; parents of the breaking birth.
comparators_or_controls: Starts of growing kind that are not proved sources; the gate row G.
resource_budget: Each run under ten minutes and 12 GB.
decision_rule: The reading fixed in the pre-registration (90% and 50% bars) and each prediction's 'Fails when' column.
nonclaims: An exploratory study on two recorded populations with about six independent sources; no all-size statement.
